verdict.rationale: Salesforce's own materials describe AI-powered insights for reps, including AI-generated lead scoring shown inside the Sales Cloud dashboard. Its pricing pages list Predictive Forecasting and Lead Scoring. Pipeline insights are surfaced in-product to speed prospecting and opportunity management. missing for 10: in-depth product documentation of how insights and suggestions are generated and presented (e.g., next-best-action recommendations), independent or hands-on corroboration that the AI insights work as marketed.
